name: Berdakh
legacy: He propagated equality and women's rights.

checks.lead: Berdakh, pseudonym of Berdimurat son of Gargabay (Karakalpak: Бердақ; Бердимурат Ғарғабай улы, 1827–1900) was a Karakalpak poet.
